description: A cutout defines clipping regions to exclude specific areas from rendering. Supports single planes, polygon sets, and oriented boxes.

appliesTo.description: Ids of the scene objects this cutout applies to. Only the listed resources will be clipped.

items.description: Id of the scene object this cutout should be applied to.

ClippingPolygon.description: A single clipping polygon defined by its outer ring positions.

positions.description: The points describing the outer ring of the clipping polygon.

PolygonSetCutout.description: A cutout defined by one or more clipping polygons.

cutoutType.description: Discriminator indicating this uses polygon set geometry.

enabled.description: Whether this cutout is active. If false, the cutout should be ignored during rendering.

inverse.description: Clipping behavior: false = hide interior (area inside any polygon), true = hide exterior (area outside all polygons).

transformFromClip.description: Optional transform from local coordinate space to world coordinates.

transformToClip.description: Optional transform from world coordinates to local coordinate space.

polygons.description: Array of clipping polygons. The cutout-level 'inverse' flag applies uniformly to all polygons. Per-polygon masking is not supported.

ClippingPlane.description: A single clipping plane that defines a half-space for clipping geometry.

normal.description: Inward unit normal vector. Points toward the region that should be kept when clipping.

distance.description: Signed distance from origin to plane.

PlaneCutout.description: A cutout defined by a single clipping plane.

cutoutType.description: Discriminator indicating this uses a single plane geometry.

enabled.description: Whether this cutout is active. If false, the cutout should be ignored during rendering.

plane.description: A single clipping plane that defines a half-space for clipping geometry.

ClippingBox.description: An oriented box used for clipping geometry.

halfExtents.description: Half-dimensions along each axis [halfWidth, halfHeight, halfDepth]. For a cube, all extents are equal.

BoxCutout.description: A cutout defined by an oriented box.

cutoutType.description: Discriminator indicating this uses box geometry.

enabled.description: Whether this cutout is active. If false, the cutout should be ignored during rendering.

inverse.description: Clipping behavior: false = hide interior, true = hide exterior.

transformFromClip.description: Optional transform from local coordinate space to world coordinates.

transformToClip.description: Optional transform from world coordinates to local coordinate space.

box.description: An oriented box used for clipping geometry.
